- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fly fishing is an amazing sport and the assistant is excited to help the user get started.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for beginners in fly fishing include investing in the right gear, learning basic knots, choosing the right fly, practicing casting, understanding the basics of fly fishing, starting on calm water, getting guidance, being patient and persistent, respecting the environment, and having fun.
